-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB__freepages` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem bbolt.DB.freepages.wp_proof [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt]
    (wp_beginTx_s : bbolt.DB.beginTx_s.spec) (wp_Rollback_r : bbolt.Tx.Rollback_r.spec) (wp_meta :
    bbolt.DB.meta.spec) (wp_Pgid : bbolt.internal.common.Meta.Pgid.spec) (wp_check :
    bbolt.Tx.recursivelyCheckBucket_root.spec) : bbolt.DB.freepages.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.DB.freepages.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (K : bbolt.BC) (C : bbolt.CommitSt) (b : Loc) (l : Nat),
    C.metaOk →
      bbolt.treeOK C →
        C.hwm ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
          ⊢
            ∀ Φ,
              K.core ∗
                  bbolt.sparePair K.B K.db K.sp ∗
                    ghostVar K.B.cur (Qp.half 1).half C ∗
                      ghostVar K.B.map (Qp.half 1) (some (b, l)) ∗
                        bbolt.metaCellsQ (Qp.half 1).half (some (b, l)) C ∗
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB go!"opened" K.db) true
                            (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ s,
                      ownSlice s (bbolt.freeIdsOf C) (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                          ownSliceCap w64 s (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                            ⌜bbolt.PgidsIncr (bbolt.freeIdsOf C) ∧
                                  (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ bbolt.freeIdsOf C → 2 ≤ BitVec.toNat x) ∧
                                    (bbolt.freeIdsOf C).length < 2 ^ 63⌝ ∗
                              bbolt.sparePair K.B K.db K.sp ∗
                                ghostVar K.B.cur (Qp.half 1).half C ∗
                                  ghostVar K.B.map (Qp.half 1) (some (b, l)) ∗
                                    bbolt.metaCellsQ (Qp.half 1).half (some (b, l)) C ∗
                                      typedPointsto
                                        (structFieldRef go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB go!"opened"
                                          K.db)
                                        true (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) -∗
                        Φ (intoVal s)) -∗
                  WP
                    ((intoVal
                        (methods go_etcd_io.bbolt.DB.ty.PointerType
                          go!"freepages" (intoVal K.db)))
                      (intoVal ()))
                    {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.rdTxK.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [hos : HasExt Fs.fsExt] (K K✝ : bbolt.BC)
    (e_K : K = K✝) (tx tx✝ : Loc) (e_tx : tx = tx✝) (src src✝ : bbolt.PairSrc) (e_src : src = src✝)
    (q q✝ : Qp) (e_q : q = q✝) (T T✝ : bbolt.TxView) (e_T : T = T✝) (v v✝ : bbolt.View) (e_v : v =
    v✝) : bbolt.rdTxK K tx src q T v = bbolt.rdTxK K✝ tx✝ src✝ q✝ T✝ v✝
